zh: 可在文件名菜单中直接选择已打开的 Word 文档，并自动移除已关闭文档。切换会保护未保存草稿，只读或状态不明的文档不会接管编辑。修复新文档插入等待、重新安装后的服务恢复，以及功能区上一公式、下一公式和快速重开工具页的问题。启动通知失败时有限重试，并清理重复的网页侧栏代码。
en: Choose among open Word documents from the filename menu, with closed documents removed automatically. Switching protects changed drafts and rejects read-only or unavailable targets. Fix insertion waits, service recovery after reinstall, Previous / Next navigation, and tool selection during rapid reopening. Retry failed launch notifications within a fixed limit and remove duplicate web sidebar code.
